sloka: राज्ये त्वामभिषेक्ष्यामि मधोस्तु नगरे शुभे ।निवेशय महाबाहो भरतं यद्यवेक्षसे ।। ७.६२.१६ ॥
transliteration: rājye tvāmabhiṣekṣyāmi madhostu nagare śubhe ।niveśaya mahābāho bharataṁ yadyavekṣase ।। 7.62.16 ॥

translations.english: I shall install you in the auspicious city of Madhu's kingdom; O mighty-armed one, establish Bharata there if you care for him.
